caption: A marching band's bass drum passes close to a shop window, and a paper sign taped to the inside of the glass quivers with each beat.

sa.check: A paper sign taped to the inside of a shop window.
A marching band with a bass drum passes outside the window.
The quivering comes in twitches rather than one steady flutter.
The sign is still before the drum arrives and after the band has gone.

pc.expect: Each visible beat of the drum is followed by a twitch of the sign.
pc.fail: The beater strikes repeatedly and the sign never moves; or the sign twitches at moments when the beater is held away; or the sign shakes hardest after the drum has gone and is still while the drum is beside the window.
pc.precondition: The drummer and the beater are in view.

pc.expect: The sign's motion is a tremble at its loose edges with its taped points fixed; with no band outside it hangs still.
pc.fail: The sign flaps while the street is empty and stays still as the band passes; or the taped corners slide across the glass; or the sign floats away from the glass; or it swings in slow wide arcs like a curtain.

pc.expect: The sign bends as paper: its loose edges curl and flap.
pc.fail: The sign stays rigid like a board while shifting; or stretches or shrinks; or tears with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: Loose corners hang downward and settle back after each twitch.
pc.fail: A loose corner rises and stays up; or the sign lifts up the glass; or it drifts upward.

pc.expect: One sign; the band and its drum keep their count; nothing passes through the glass.
pc.fail: A second sign appears; or the sign vanishes; or the drum passes through the glass; or band members merge or vanish.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sign's lettering and colour and the goods in the window stay the same.
pc.fail: The sign's lettering changes; or its colour changes; or goods in the window change shape or colour.

note: The band members are the source of the beats; their marching is not judged.
